description: Conservative lexical-block master elision: explicit default-sensitive call effects, late removal of proven block records/hooks; runtime and function/task/library/collection policies unchanged. Native CI confirmation retained separately in host-performance-block-masters-ci.json.

proof.default: Every source/foreign/indirect/unclassified call may observe master ancestry.
proof.independent: Only audited memory zero/copy, plain arena rewind, array offset and basic exception-raise emission sites.
proof.scope_hooks: Candidate lifecycle hooks are a separate classification; not generally claimed independent.
proof.decision: No observing calls emitted during the complete lexical block interval, including all branches and child scopes. Monotonic evidence is not rolled back by lexical-stack copies.
proof.preserved: Transfer depths, checkpoints, cleanup, exception checks/source traces and all unproven masters.
proof.filter: Exact candidate record allocation and enter/activate/await/leave lines after return-offset expansion.

limits: Local Darwin arm64 correctness and matched performance evidence; native confirmation retained separately in host-performance-block-masters-ci.json.
Not an interprocedural-purity proof: unknown and source calls retain masters even when the callee might be harmless.
Whole-program timing differences include generated-code layout; not isolated helper timings.
